Korg Minilogue XD, bought from a guy in Dennistoun in June 2023 for £410. Program slots I care about, so I stop overwriting the good ones.

## P-041 "Necropolis Pad"

For the horror night intro. Both VCOs saw, VCO2 detuned +7 cents, cutoff at 38%, resonance 20%. Amp EG attack 1.2 s, release 3 s. Chorus on, delay off. Voice mode POLY. Played the Andalusian cadence from [[Chord progressions]] on it, slowed to 54 BPM, and it was suitably grim.

## P-052 "Clyde Bass"

Mono, VCO1 square, sub-octave via VCO2 one octave down, cutoff 22%, filter EG intensity +45%, decay 180 ms. Punchy. Used on the Rankine Family Band demo, July 2024.

## P-063 "Bells for Ishbel"

The digital multi-engine on the user oscillator "VPM", ratio 3.5, feedback low. For the film club Christmas screening of "It's a Wonderful Life" (1946), 20 December 2024. Ishbel Rankine asked for "something twinkly". Twinkly delivered.

## Patch hygiene

- Back up via the Librarian app to `minilogue-backup-2025-02.mnlgxdlib`. Last time I didn't, I lost 30 patches when a firmware update reset everything.
- Name every patch the day I make it.
- Slots 001 to 040 are factory, don't touch.
